notes: Version 2.3 corrects the status of the gauge-group statements. The SU(2) uniqueness theorem is replaced by Proposition 2.5: on the spinor carrier supplied conditionally by O23, and under the neutral-sector hypothesis of O27, the group acting faithfully on the carrier is SU(2); this is a consistency statement, not a selection, and a remark shows that the definition of the gauge group does not force a quaternionic group. Attributions to Q1, Q2, the Foundation paper, O27, Q5a and the Born-Infeld capacity paper are corrected to what those papers state; the spatial continuum is stated as open (Q5a); the Yang-Mills action remains a structural motivation. The title states a conditional construction.
